spans.text: Each row is a work-in-progress policy the author tracked for twelve weeks; the columns give the average number of items in progress, items finished per week, and average days from start to finish.

items.text: Throughput barely moves across policies, from 9.5 to 10.1 items per week.
Average cycle time falls from 31 days with no limit to 10 days with a team limit of 15 and 8.5 days with a per-person limit of 2.
The per-person limit holds the least work in progress (12) and has the shortest cycle time.

takeaway.text: Limiting work in progress cut cycle time to about a third while throughput stayed flat: the teams finished work sooner without working faster.
